# 7408 - Quadruple 2-input AND gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7408.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7408.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 6 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7408 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7408.png) | ![7408 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/and2.png) | ![7408 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/and2.png) |

One rectangle split down the middle by a vertical line: left half empty, right half holds a triangle pointing right (two lines from its left corners meeting at the middle of the right edge).

How to tell it on a drawing: Split box with a triangle in the right half = AND. The manual draws AND as NAND followed by an inverter, in one box.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Y = 1A AND 1B | 1Y is the AND of 1A, 1B. |
| 6 | 2Y = 2A AND 2B | 2Y is the AND of 2A, 2B. |
| 8 | 3Y = 3A AND 3B | 3Y is the AND of 3A, 3B. |
| 11 | 4Y = 4A AND 4B | 4Y is the AND of 4A, 4B. |

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 17.5 | 27 |
| any | Y | PHL | 12 | 19 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.
